name: Mikel Delamar
source:
Chemist-biologist, scientist, now works as a bartender in the "Begging eyes".
Previously, he was a full-time chemist in a foreign company, which was liquidated by law enforcement due to unclear circumstances. After that Mikel moved to the dorm and has an ordinary life.

He is a genius but terrible in home life, so living with someone really simplifies everything.
But many people wonder why such a brilliant mind gave up scientific activity.
And what's going on in his room?
